answer: Gate every action behind a co-signature quorum. Like a furnace door that only opens for a blend of metals, the rule demands several independent, aged signatories per operation: each must carry their own reputation, their own ferrous-strength track record, and lose stake if the action misbehaves. A clone kernel can mint wallets cheaply, but copper-thin puppet keys with no history satisfy no one, so an attacker pays one genuine relationship per required signer.
